maddeler.e:
نتذابح (form VI)
# نَتَذَابَحُ (nataḏābaḥu) /na.ta.ðaː.ba.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَذَابَحَ (taḏābaḥa)
# نَتَذَابَحَ (nataḏābaḥa) /na.ta.ðaː.ba.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَذَابَحَ (taḏābaḥa)
# نَتَذَابَحْ (nataḏābaḥ) /na.ta.ðaː.baħ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَذَابَحَ (taḏābaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
